text:
Nina (Onboarding Lead): Hi team 1 kicking off MosaicGrocer onboarding. Target: pilot (single store) in 30 days, production pilot at day 45. Need stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and obvious blockers. 20-30m kickoff today/tomorrow?

Owen (CSM): I can do tomorrow 11am PT. I'll run the weekly health tracker and customer updates.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow 11am PT works. Please confirm if MosaicGrocer needs HIPAA-style controls or just SOC2; affects private deployment timeline. Also need infra POC for allowlist/VPC.

Carmen - MosaicGrocer (Customer): 11am fine. We require SOC2 and want VPC peering eventually, but can start in hosted sandbox for pilot. Security team will want encryption-at-rest details.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): Draft success criteria to align on at kickoff: 1) Sandbox E2E flow up with product team able to submit orders; 2) 95th pct latency <350ms for 256-token requests in pilot env; 3) Acceptance pass on our 8k retail prompt suite; 4) Recording + docs for product & infra teams; 5) Baseline engagement metric (7-day DAU) defined for renewal signals.

Jules (Renewals): Add cost-review watch 1 they mentioned a procurement check in 60 days. I'll tag renewal_watch and add expected ARR tier for forecasting.

Owen (CSM): I'll build a 30/60/90 health plan and include a "procurement_watch" flag. Also propose a day-14 quick feedback survey to the product team.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tech starter list I'll bring: API key provisioning, model suggestion (redwood/opt-13b-quant for latency/cost balance), sample payloads, and small-scale load test plan. Sanity curl after key:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"Get me the weekly ad copy"}'
```

Kei (Enablement): I'll prepare a short quickstart (slides + 20-min recording) and a troubleshooting cheat sheet. Recommend a live enablement hour on day 5 after sandbox integration.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): @calendar-bot please create a 25-min kickoff tomorrow 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm criteria, infra checklist, migration risk & owners.

calendar-bot: Created event "MosaicGrocer 1 Onboard Kickoff" for 2026-04-21 14:00 ET. Invitees: Nina, Owen, Ravi, Carmen, Kei, Jules.

Carmen - MosaicGrocer (Customer): I'll share infra POC and an S3 link to the labeled prompts (~8k) before the meeting. Also will request SOC2 docs from legal.

Jules (Renewals): Mark private-deploy preference as medium risk until SOC2 confirmation. I'll follow up with procurement contact details.

Owen (CSM): Action list for kickoff:
- Carmen: infra POC + S3 prompts (before kickoff)
- Ravi: tech checklist + mini load-test template (1 day post-kickoff)
- Owen: 30/60/90 plan + DAU target (3 days)
- Kei: quickstart + recording (day 5)
- Jules: add renewal_watch + procurement contact in CRM

Kei (Enablement): I'll also include a brief "what to monitor" one-pager for product managers.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): Risk note: if MosaicGrocer insists on private deployment immediately, timeline extends ~3-4 weeks. Carmen please confirm preference by EOD tomorrow.

Carmen - MosaicGrocer (Customer): We'll start in hosted sandbox for pilot and escalate to VPC peering after the pilot if all looks good. Confirming EOD.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): Perfect 1 I'll lead the kickoff and publish meeting notes + owners after. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Owen (CSM): Thanks all, see you tomorrow.

Kei (Enablement): +1 will bring enablement materials.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): See you at kickoff.
